text:
pagerbot: INCIDENT ALERT — Serving-runtime-prod: elevated GPU OOM rate during prefill phase (us-west-2). Paging infra-oncall. Affected namespace: redwood-serving.

infra-oncall: acked. seeing container restarts on node-gpu-12/13. paging SRE.

sanjay: oncall here. quick ask: is this concentrated to a single model or many? any recent deploys?

alice: rolling logs show repeated failures during long-context prefill. sample:
```
E tensorflow: 2026-03-17 03:14:12.345678 CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 12.30 GiB (error 2)
W serving: prefill: sequence_len=32768 tokens, kv_cache ballooning, container -> Restarting
```

ev an: no prod deploys in the past 30m. traffic spike of long-window requests from a single customer prd-392 seen 03:12-03:20.

maya: customer-impact: ~2.1% 5xx on generation endpoint in us-west-2, some customers reported timeouts. support notified.

sanjay: mitigation plan:
- roll back aggressive max_seq (apply runtime override to 8192) via configmap
- enable prefill trim (runtime flag prefill.trim=true) for heavy tails
- temporarily reduce concurrency per GPU (runtime.max_concurrency=4)
- evict any queued >16k token jobs

evan: I'll push a hotpatch. running:
```
kubectl -n redwood-serving set env ds/serving-runtime RUNTIME_MAX_SEQ=8192 RUNTIME_PREFILL_TRIM=true RUNTIME_MAX_CONCURRENCY=4
kubectl rollout restart ds/serving-runtime
```

infra-oncall: preflight: adding a short BGP drain for node-gpu-13 to break restart loop while patch lands.

pagerbot: pager assigned to sanjay (ack). escalation timeout set to 15m.

alice: note: we saw 'cuda driver reset' on node-gpu-13 before the OOMs. likely memory fragmentation+huge prefill windows.

sanjay: Evan, go ahead with config change. Maya — prepare customer comms: brief note + ETA for mitigation.

evan: applied env changes and restarted ds/serving-runtime. watch logs.

alice: after restart: immediate reduction in OOMs, container restarts dropped to zero on node-gpu-12/13. still monitoring prefix error rate.

maya: drafting message to impacted tenants: "We're mitigating a GPU prefill memory issue impacting long-context requests in us-west-2. We're applying runtime throttles and expect recovery within 15-30 minutes."

sanjay: follow-ups:
- create a short-term alert rule for prefill token length spikes
- add automated prefill-trim policy for >12k tokens for hosted tier
- schedule long-term work: KV cache compaction and better fragmentation handling

evan: added temporary metric: gauge(prefill_oom_rate) and a dashboard panel.

pagerbot: Incident status: mitigated. severity lowered to P2. oncall: sanjay. incident channel: #inc-1934567001 for postmortem.

maya: customers notified. support posting updates now.

alice: saving logs and creating a minimal repro for ML team: sample request that caused high kv cache growth (redacted customer payload).

sanjay: handing off to SRE rotation for follow-up. paging infra-rotation.

infra-oncall: ack handoff. I'll own the postmortem and root cause triage.

pagerbot: thread closed by infra-oncall after recovery validation.
